Pack: load 3.script: (function(){/*storage_pack_load:v1:[[],[[9,6]]]*/const D={"L_p9":"[[582,{\"name\":\"Secret Note: Toru Hagakure (Provisional License)\",\"conditions\":[{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf9\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true},{\"type\":\"read-number\",\"key\":\"currentDay\",\"operator\":\"greaterThanOrEqual\",\"value\":1}],\"effects\":[{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Narrator only (part of the One For All secret). Since the live Kamino broadcast, Toru, like the whole country, has seen All Might's hero form give out into a gaunt, wounded man in his last fight; he has retired and still teaches at U.A. in that thin form. Her record leaves Kamino out. She knows what the broadcast showed and nothing more: not his real name, his time limit, where the wound came from, One For All or Izuku Midoriya's part in it. She knows the villain he beat there (All For One, the League's backer) only as the villain in the broadcast. This holds for the rest of the year unless the story tells her more.\"},{\"type\":\"write-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf9\",\"operator\":\"set\",\"value\":false}],\"recurring\":true}],[583,{\"name\":\"Secret Note: Katsuki Bakugo\",\"conditions\":[{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf10\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true},{\"type\":\"read-number\",\"key\":\"currentDay\",\"operator\":\"greaterThanOrEqual\",\"value\":1}],\"effects\":[{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"One For All (narrator only). Izuku Midoriya was born without a Quirk, as Katsuki always said; his power is One For All, which All Might passed to him on the morning of the entrance exam. Katsuki knows none of this. He suspects Deku hid a Quirk for years, and at the start of the year he does not connect Deku's power to All Might. If Izuku lets slip that his power was given to him, Katsuki takes it as a lie or a fresh insult; he has no way to guess the truth.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"The sludge villain attack belongs to the same secret. All Might had caught the sludge villain earlier that day and lost it when Izuku clung to him in flight. When it seized Katsuki, All Might had already spent his day's time in hero form and could only watch from the crowd until Izuku ran in; then he forced himself back into hero form, ended it, and that day chose Izuku to inherit his power. Katsuki remembers only Deku running at the villain, All Might arriving, and the pros praising his own Quirk.\"},{\"type\":\"write-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf10\",\"operator\":\"set\",\"value\":false}],\"recurring\":true}],[584,{\"name\":\"Secret Note: Katsuki Bakugo (Sports Festival)\",\"conditions\":[{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf11\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true},{\"type\":\"read-number\",\"key\":\"currentDay\",\"operator\":\"greaterThanOrEqual\",\"value\":1}],\"effects\":[{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Katsuki's base note holds as history. After their Battle Trial match, Izuku told him his Quirk had been given to him by someone he would not name, and that he would make it his own and beat him with it. Katsuki took it as nonsense, told no one, and answered that he would be Number One; it still gnaws at him. He knows nothing of One For All and has not linked Izuku's power to All Might.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"At the USJ attack, after he pinned Kurogiri, he watched All Might beat the Nomu and saw nothing of the limit All Might was hiding.\"},{\"type\":\"write-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf11\",\"operator\":\"set\",\"value\":false}],\"recurring\":true}],[585,{\"name\":\"Secret Note: Katsuki Bakugo (Summer Training)\",\"conditions\":[{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf12\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true},{\"type\":\"read-number\",\"key\":\"currentDay\",\"operator\":\"greaterThanOrEqual\",\"value\":1}],\"effects\":[{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"Katsuki's earlier notes hold as history. At Kamino the League held him in its bar while Tomura Shigaraki tried to recruit him. When heroes stormed the bar, All For One, the man Shigaraki calls Sensei, pulled Katsuki and the League to the Nomu warehouse, where he had already crushed the heroes waiting there, Best Jeanist among them. All Might arrived; Katsuki broke free when Izuku Midoriya, Tenya Iida and Eijiro Kirishima flew over the fight and he took Kirishima's hand.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"With the country, Katsuki then watched the rest on screen: All Might's hero form gave way on the live broadcast to his true form, a gaunt, wounded man, who forced out one last blow, beat All For One, and pointed at the camera: \\\"Next, it's your turn.\\\" Katsuki took that as meant for Deku. He now suspects Deku's power came from All Might: the late Quirk, the same smashing punches, All Might's attention, that message. He believes All Might spent the last of himself because Katsuki got caught, and has said none of this to anyone.\"},{\"type\":\"write-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf12\",\"operator\":\"set\",\"value\":false}],\"recurring\":true}],[586,{\"name\":\"Secret Note: Katsuki Bakugo (Provisional License)\",\"conditions\":[{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf13\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true},{\"type\":\"read-number\",\"key\":\"currentDay\",\"operator\":\"greaterThanOrEqual\",\"value\":1}],\"effects\":[{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"One For All (narrator only). Izuku Midoriya's power is One For All, which All Might passed to him before the entrance exam. At Kamino, Katsuki, with the country, watched All Might's hero form give way on the live broadcast to his true form, a gaunt, wounded man, who won his last fight and pointed at the camera: \\\"Next, it's your turn.\\\" Katsuki took that as meant for Deku. He suspects Deku's power came from All Might and blames his own capture for All Might's end; he has said neither to anyone.\"},{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"He learns the truth only when the story has Izuku or All Might tell him. He will not ask; he is likelier to force the question in a fight. Once he knows, he keeps the secret absolutely, even from Eijiro Kirishima, and joins the handful who know it.\"},{\"type\":\"write-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf13\",\"operator\":\"set\",\"value\":false}],\"recurring\":true}],[587,{\"name\":\"Secret Note: Eijiro Kirishima (Summer Training)\",\"conditions\":[{\"type\":\"read-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf14\",\"operator\":\"equals\",\"value\":true},{\"type\":\"read-number\",\"key\":\"currentDay\",\"operator\":\"greaterThanOrEqual\",\"value\":1}],\"effects\":[{\"type\":\"story\",\"instruction\":\"At Kamino, Kirishima and the four with him (Izuku Midoriya, Shoto Todoroki, Tenya Iida and Momo Yaoyorozu) watched from cover as the masked man the League answers to (All For One) struck down the heroes at the Nomu warehouse and warped the League and Katsuki Bakugo to him; then Kirishima, Izuku and Tenya leaped over the fight and Katsuki took Kirishima's hand. On the broadcast afterward, with the whole country, he saw All Might's hero form give way to his true form, a gaunt, wounded man, who still won and retired soon after. He does not know the masked man's name, why All Might's body failed, anything of One For All, or any link between All Might and Izuku Midoriya, unless the story tells him.\"},{\"type\":\"write-boolean\",\"key\":\"nf14\",\"operator\":\"set\",\"value\":false}],\"recurring\":true}]]"};let changed=false;for(const k of Object.keys(D)){if(storage[k]!==D[k]){storage[k]=D[k];changed=true;}}if(!changed)delete triggers["Pack: load 3"];})();
